title: Scholarly Distance: Questions and Modest Claims

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The reading text about Antal Szerb presents true wisdom as giving up the illusion of infallibility (*tévedhetetlenség*) and shows scholarly humility (*tudósi alázat*): it questions sweeping claims and notices the frailties of human nature. The text is an original text about his essays, not his own words.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Scholarly distancing in this tradition is achieved by replacing grand assertions with interrogatives, tentative modals, and gentle smiles: *Biztosak lehetünk-e ebben? Aligha. De talán éppen a bizonytalanság teszi széppé a keresést.*
